description: Provider-level mapping for official-first company career discovery. Public APIs are marked separately from authenticated or page-pattern strategies so callers do not assume every ATS has a supported unauthenticated listing endpoint.

detection_signals: greenhouse.io jobs links with gh_jid query parameters

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for public GET
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: List public job posts with title, location, absolute_url, department, office, metadata, and optional content.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for public GET
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Retrieve one public job post.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: HTML fallback for boards that are easier to parse through the hosted embed.

extraction_strategy: Derive board_token from Greenhouse host path or embed query.
Call the Job Board API first and parse jobs[].title, jobs[].location.name, jobs[].absolute_url, jobs[].updated_at, jobs[].departments, and jobs[].offices.
Filter by India location signals, user role-family titles, and required keywords.
Fallback to hosted board or custom employer page links only when the API returns no usable jobs.
health_check_hints: A healthy public board usually returns HTTP 200 JSON with a jobs array and meta object.
HTTP 404 usually means the board token is wrong or no public board exists.
HTML embed health can be checked by finding opening links or department sections.
known_caveats: Some employers expose Greenhouse jobs through custom career URLs, so absolute_url may not be boards.greenhouse.io.
Prospect or general application posts can appear beside real requisitions and should be filtered.
Location and department metadata can be sparse or inconsistent.
Application submission requires authentication and must not be attempted directly from the client.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for published postings
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: List published public postings on the global Lever instance.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for published postings
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: List published public postings on the EU Lever instance.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for published postings
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Retrieve one public posting.

extraction_strategy: Derive site from the first path segment on jobs.lever.co or jobs.eu.lever.co.
Try global API, then EU API if the source host or first call indicates EU.
Parse text, hostedUrl, applyUrl, categories.location, categories.team, categories.commitment, workplaceType, and salaryRange when present.
Filter published postings by role terms, country/city signals, workplace type, and employer ownership.
health_check_hints: HTTP 200 with an array response is healthy even when the array is empty.
HTTP 404 usually means the site slug or instance is wrong.
Respect 429 responses on application endpoints; Career Seek should only link to the hosted apply page.
known_caveats: The API does not support full-text search across all jobs.
Only published postings are visible; internal postings are hidden.
CORS is intentionally limited for browser callers, so server-side fetch is safer.
Custom application questions are not fully exposed by the public postings API.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for published public postings
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: List currently published job postings for an Ashby job board.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Hosted job detail page and apply handoff.

extraction_strategy: Derive job_board_name from the Ashby hosted job board path.
Call the official posting API before the hosted page or non-user GraphQL fallback.

Parse jobs[].title, jobs[].location, jobs[].secondaryLocations, jobs[].department, jobs[].team, jobs[].workplaceType, jobs[].employmentType, jobs[].jobUrl, jobs[].applyUrl, and compensation when present.
Drop unlisted postings unless they were explicitly imported by URL.
health_check_hints: A healthy board returns HTTP 200 JSON with apiVersion and jobs.
Validate that jobUrl or applyUrl stays on jobs.ashbyhq.com before presenting an apply link.
If the public API fails but the hosted board loads, mark the source degraded and fall back to page extraction.
known_caveats: Board names can be case-sensitive and may not match the company brand exactly.
Compensation is optional and only included when requested and configured.
Unlisted postings may appear in API responses; do not treat them as discoverable unless explicit URL import found them.
The older non-user GraphQL route is an implementation detail, not the preferred strategy.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for public external career pages
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Employer-owned Workday external career site.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: page-context dependent
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Tenant-specific candidate-site JSON call when discovered from the official career page; treat as page implementation, not a universal public API contract.

extraction_strategy: Start from the employer's official careers link, not a guessed Workday tenant.
Use the public candidate site, embedded JSON, sitemap, or page-discovered requests for listing data.
Parse title, requisition id, locations, posted date, job family, remote type, and external apply URL when exposed.
Keep Workday pages in official-first priority but downgrade to browser extraction when JSON request shape drifts.
health_check_hints: Check the public career-site URL for HTTP 200 and candidate-site text or app shell scripts.
Confirm that searches for India or configured city hints return a result count or stable empty state.
A login prompt, infinite app shell, or 403 should mark the provider degraded and trigger fallback discovery.
known_caveats: There is no single documented unauthenticated public Workday jobs API that works for every tenant.
Candidate accounts are tenant-specific and should not be automated.
Public page request payloads, data-center numbers, locales, and career-site names vary by employer.
Many Workday postings require repetitive application forms, so Career Seek should deep-link and warn users before apply.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for public job detail pages
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Hosted public job detail page.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for public localized job detail pages
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Localized hosted public job detail page.

extraction_strategy: Use official employer career pages and indexed Rippling job detail URLs as discovery inputs.
Extract job detail pages conservatively and keep the canonical hosted apply link.
When an employer board page exposes structured data, parse only fields present in the public page.
If listing discovery is unavailable, rely on Google for Jobs discovery or manual company import before broad portals.
health_check_hints: A public job detail should return HTTP 200 and contain the company name, title, and apply action.
Locale-prefixed and non-locale URLs should both be recognized.
If only detail URLs are discoverable, mark board_listing_health as unknown and detail_page_health as healthy.
known_caveats: No stable public jobs listing API is documented for unauthenticated Career Seek use.
Some pages are detail-only and may not expose a list of all jobs for a company.
Locale prefixes and company slugs can vary.
Rippling is also an HRIS and finance platform, so avoid confusing product pages with ATS job pages.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: basic auth with BambooHR API key and ATS permissions
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: List job opening summaries for an authenticated BambooHR tenant.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: basic auth with BambooHR API key and ATS permissions
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: List applications for authenticated owner workflows; not used for public discovery.

extraction_strategy: For public discovery, start from the official employer career page and parse public BambooHR job links.
Use the authenticated official API only when the user or employer supplies a permitted API key.
Parse postingTitle/title, job id, status, created date, lead, location, employment type, and public posting URL when present.
Never infer applicant data from public pages.
health_check_hints: Authenticated API health should distinguish 401 invalid credentials from 403 insufficient ATS permissions.
Public page health should confirm the employer BambooHR subdomain and visible open positions.
When credentials are absent, mark api_health as not_configured rather than failed.
known_caveats: Official job summaries API requires credentials and appropriate ATS settings access.
Many BambooHR public career pages are simple HTML and may not expose full job metadata.
Company domains are tenant-specific and can differ from public brand names.
Application and candidate endpoints are owner workflows, not candidate discovery sources.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: basic auth for official API access
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Return jobs matching iCIMS Career Portal filters.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: basic auth for official API access
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Retrieve supported portal search filters.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for public job detail pages
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Hosted public job detail and apply page.

extraction_strategy: Use public iCIMS career portal pages for unauthenticated discovery.
Use the official Job Portal API only when customerId, portalId, and credentials are configured.
Parse searchResults[].portalUrl, self, id, updatedDate from the API and hydrate details from public portal pages when needed.
Cache filters per portal because iCIMS supports portal-specific filter vocabularies.
health_check_hints: Authenticated API health should verify 200 responses for both portal search and filters.
Public page health should confirm job detail pages render title, company, and location.
Track API result cache age separately from page scrape timestamp.
known_caveats: Official API access normally requires credentials.
Portal URLs and customer IDs are not always obvious from the public brand.
Search results can be cached and may lag the live portal.
Portal filter names and options vary by employer.

detection_signals: career site builder pages hosted by SAP SuccessFactors

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: authenticated OData user with Recruiting permissions
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Query job requisition data for an authorized SuccessFactors tenant.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: authenticated OData user with Recruiting permissions
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Retrieve one job requisition by id.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.url_template: official employer external career site URL
official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none for public external postings when configured
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Candidate-facing external career site posted from Recruiting Management.

extraction_strategy: For public discovery, start from the employer official career site and parse public external postings.
Use OData JobRequisition only for authorized tenant integrations.
Normalize requisition status, locale-specific titles, jobReqId, location, department, posting status, and external apply URL.
Prefer the canonical external career site URL over copied portal content.
health_check_hints: Authenticated OData health should verify metadata access and query permission for JobRequisition.
Public career site health should check for external search results and language/locale availability.
Permission errors should be categorized separately from empty public postings.
known_caveats: OData fields vary by customer template and field-level permissions.
External career site visibility depends on whether requisitions are posted externally.
Language and locale mismatches can hide public postings.
SuccessFactors public pages can be heavily customized and may require browser rendering.

providers.display_name: Custom or Unknown Employer Career Page
detection_signals: careers, jobs, join-us, work-with-us, opportunities, openings, or recruitment paths on employer-owned domains
structured data containing JobPosting schema.org markup
links to known ATS hosts without enough information to identify provider

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none unless employer gates the page
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Employer-owned custom career page.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none unless employer gates the page
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Common employer-owned jobs path.

official_endpoints_or_patterns.auth: none when public
official_endpoints_or_patterns.purpose: Discover public job detail URLs on employer-owned domains.

extraction_strategy: Resolve from a curated company source or user-provided official URL.
Parse schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD first, then visible job cards and links.
Use conservative title, location, company, posted date, apply URL, and description extraction.
Record unknown provider and extraction confidence so results can be validated manually.
health_check_hints: Check employer-domain ownership, HTTP 200, and visible career or job text.
Mark as gated if login, CAPTCHA, or regional blocking is detected.
Track selector drift and no-job states separately.
known_caveats: Custom pages have no shared schema and often drift.
Single-page apps may require browser rendering.
Some pages list teams without live openings.
Manual validation is required before treating a new custom source as stable.
